entities.summary: Ramona Aurelia Parra Alarcón was a Chilean Nitrate worker and communist. She was one of six people shot to death during a demonstration in Santiago de Chile, also known as the Bulnes Square Massacre. She is best known for being the first martyr of the Communist Youth of Chile.
